title: place/v1
description: Shared result of single-file stage or place for lam and soay. tool is lam or soay. sha256 is null on refused, conflict, and sha-mismatch; the staged file sha on dry-run and staged; the final dest sha on placed. old_sha256 is the dest hash on sha-mismatch and on a replace dry-run. size is the staged or placed file size, and null when the staged file is missing or the hex is bad. trash_path may be null (always null for lam). Exit 1 does not promise dest is unchanged; callers re-hash dest.
